name: HEXCAP
recent: HEXCAP 于 2026 年 11 月 19 日公布多项企业提案（MULTIPLE PROPOSALS），并在 10 月 7 日公告提供财务援助。公司于 8 月 27 日发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩。
notable: 公布多项企业提案（MULTIPLE PROPOSALS）。
公告提供财务援助（PROVISION OF FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE）。
risks: 公司公告提供财务援助，涉及资金或担保支持。
多项企业提案的具体条款尚未在标题中披露，需留意后续公告。

ann.title: Quarterly rpt on consolidated results for the financial period ended 30/06/2026

recent_en: HEXCAP announced multiple corporate proposals on 19 November 2026 and disclosed the provision of financial assistance on 7 October. The company released its consolidated quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 27 August.
notable_en: Disclosed the provision of financial assistance.
risks_en: The company disclosed provision of financial assistance involving funding or guarantee support.
Details of the multiple proposals were not disclosed in the headline; further announcements should be monitored.
